Priya (Product): Follow-up from the Q&A: customers want clearer windows for API stability, Console GA, Optimize beta. We discussed rough quarters; can we be more specific with weeks?
Marco (CEO): We should avoid hard dates until engineering sign-off but we can give week ranges. Tentative: API stable: week of Jun 22; Console GA: week of Jul 13; Optimize beta: week of Sep 14.
Dev (Eng): Heads-up: console migration tool has unicode edge-case failing. PR: https://git.internal/console/migrate-e2e. Plan to fix by Jun 10.
Lina (DevEx): I'll run migration scripts in staging to validate. Can someone drop sample saved queries with special chars?
Sam (SRE): Dedicated capacity reservation deadline: Jun 18 to meet GA canary. Also we recommend a 48h slow rollout, not full traffic immediately.
Priya (Product): Action items: Marco to confirm copy for marketing by Jun 5; Dev to get migration PR green by Jun 10; Lina to validate staging migration by Jun 12; Sam open capacity ticket by Jun 9.
Marco (CEO): I'll approve marketing copy once I see the blurb. Send it to me by Jun 3.
Lina (DevEx): Noted. I'll ping data team for saved query samples.
Priya (Product): Thanks all, I'll update the roadmap sheet and notify Customer Success of the tentative windows.
Priya (Product): If anything slips, flag here asap.
